chaseCohorts: Separate chase success, all-out failure and allocation-end outcomes. Do not compare censored chase totals as full innings.
statistics: Nearest-rank P10/P50/P90. Dot/boundary fractions use delivery attempts. Phase run rate uses legal balls.
repeatCheck: Every per-match non-runtime field and final event hash must agree across all 96 matches.
scope: One frozen team pairing, selected XIs, ground and fixture-captain policy. Descriptive fixed-seed diagnostic, not population-matched empirical validation or tactical causal inference.
